newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat in Egypt for talks with Mubarak.
newsitem.headline: Arafat in Egypt for talks with Mubarak.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak and Palestinian Leader Yasser Arafat held talks on Saturday expected to focus on negotiations with Israel on its long-delayed withdrawal from parts of the West Bank town of Hebron.
Foreign Minister Amr Moussa attended the meeting, which was held at the presidential palace.
Arafat, who ended a one-day visit to Paris on Friday, visits Egypt regularly to brief Mubarak on latest developments in the Palestinian-Israeli peace process.
In Paris, Arafat accused Israeli Premier Benjamin Netanyahu of procrastinating on implementing the accords on Palestinian autonomy.
Peace talks have faltered since Netanyahu came to power and are deadlocked over an Israeli troop redeployment from Hebron and dates for further pullbacks in the occupied West Bank.
